title: 雨夜后座
description: 说书人讲述：雨夜女司机与后座升温——色气靠距离与感官，不对口型

director_intent.logline: 雨夜出租车后座，说书人陪你靠近一位湿透的女司机。
director_intent.tone: 成人色气·雨夜·办事完成可说满
director_intent.theme: 边界感：门锁与呼吸谁先越线

act_structure.setup: 雨夜上车，热气与湿衣建立压迫
act_structure.confrontation: 后视镜与感官贴进，距离阶梯收紧

director_intent.audience: 完播优先的短视频观众

scenes.title: Ride
scenes.summary: 上车 → 靠近 → 感官 → 余韵

director_board.emotional_turn: 好奇 → 感官偷窥 → 身体失控
director_board.audience_question: 谁先越过这条看不见的线？
director_board.coverage_strategy: 后视镜 OTS + 锁骨特写 insert，近景加压
director_board.cut_intent: hook 后 soft_glue 升温，sensory 转 smash 压感官
director_board.image_priority: 水珠与门闩的物件特写锚定每次距离变化
director_board.sound_priority: 心跳 BGM duck，旁白第三人称保距离感

shots.title: 上车
shots.nar: 雨很急。她湿透的雨衣半敞，拉开车门，热气先扑出来。
shots.nar_en: The rain is fierce. Her wet raincoat half open, she pulls the door; heat spills out first.

dsl.subject: adult anime woman taxi driver, wet raincoat half open, heavy blush
dsl.start_pose: hand on rear door handle, body outside cab in rain
dsl.end_pose: door open, body half-in, look toward back seat — feeds shot02
dsl.story_beat: 她拉开车门，把乘客关进同一私密空间
dsl.visible_change: 车门从关到开；身体半入座舱
dsl.subtext: 她在决定要不要把乘客也淋进这摊热里——手比脑子快
dsl.playable_action: grips door handle, hesitates, pulls open wider than needed
dsl.body_state: wet skin flushed, breath held then released, fingers tremble on handle
dsl.motion: door opens, rain splash, step half-in, continuous slow dolly-in, hold end_pose, soft look — idle not speaking

shots.title: 后视镜
shots.nar: 后视镜里，锁骨上的水珠还没干，她轻轻喘了一下。
shots.nar_en: In the rearview, water still beads on her collarbones; she breathes soft.

dsl.subject: same driver in rearview mirror, wet collarbone, seductive eyes
dsl.story_beat: 距离被后视镜拉近，感官压迫开始
dsl.visible_change: 视线落入后视镜；水珠仍停在锁骨
dsl.motion: mirror glance, tight hold no push-in, soft breath, idle not speaking
